name: AiFunctions
description: Transform and enrich data with AI on Databricks.

methods.name: AiClassify
methods.description: Classifies content according to a set of provided labels. For REST API requests, the default rate limit is 1,200 requests per minute per workspace. Contact your Databricks account team to request a higher limit.

required_fields.name: content
required_fields.description: The content to classify. It accepts a plain string or the response object of [ai_parse_document](:method:AiFunctions/AiParseDocument).

required_fields.name: labels
required_fields.description: The label set to classify as. Either a JSON array of label strings (e.g. ["spam", "not_spam"]), or a JSON object mapping each label to a description (e.g. {"spam": "unsolicited bulk message", "not_spam": "a legitimate message"}). Accepts 2 to 500 labels, each 1 to 100 characters.

methods.name: AiDecide
methods.description: Turn text and structured data into decisions your application can use. Define questions and criteria to choose an option, estimate a probability, or assign a score given a provided state.

methods.name: AiExtract
methods.description: Extracts structured data from text and documents according to a provided schema. For REST API requests, the default rate limit is 120 requests per minute per workspace. Contact your Databricks account team to request a higher limit.

required_fields.name: content
required_fields.description: The text to extract from. It accepts a plain string or the response object of [ai_parse_document](:method:AiFunctions/AiParseDocument).

required_fields.name: schema
required_fields.description: The extraction schema defining the fields to extract. Either a JSON array of field names, assumed to be strings (e.g. ["company", "valuation"]), or a JSON object mapping each field to its type/description/nullability (e.g. {"company": {"type": "string", "description": "the company name"}}). Accepts up to 256 fields, 12 levels of nesting, and 500 enum values. Supported field types are string, integer, number, boolean, and enum.

methods.name: AiParseDocument
methods.description: Parse structured content from unstructured documents.

required_fields.name: content
required_fields.description: The document to parse. The REST API accepts a Unity Catalog volume path to the source file or a base64 data URL containing the file bytes (for example, data:application/pdf;base64,<encoded-file-bytes> or data:image/jpeg;base64,<encoded-file-bytes>). Supported formats: PDF, DOCX, DOC, PPTX, PPT, JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF. Accepts up to 100 pages and 100 MB per document.
